The '''ZX-10 Combat Droid''' was an advanced model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] developed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] at their research [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]]. [[Rasmus Blys]] had the line fitted with a tamper-proof security system that completely deactivated any [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] units, forcing the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to destroy the ZX-10s still in their pods during the [[Seizure of CZ-198|fighting]] at CZ-198.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ZX-10 Combat Droids are an enemy added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as part of Game Update 2.3. The ZX-10 droids are the subject of a Daily mission in CZ-198: Droid Demolition for Imperial players and Manual Shutdown for Republic players.
